from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');p=Path(__file__).parent;o=Path('/tmp/sirkit_hull_20261022/official');sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();d={'status':'INCOMPLETE','builds':[],'fixtures':[],'runs':[]}
def build(cmd):
 q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','6',*cmd],capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,(cmd,q.stderr);d['builds'].append({'command':cmd,'diagnostics':q.stderr})
build(['/usr/bin/g++','-O2','-std=c++23',str(p/'official_solution.cpp'),'-o',str(p/'official_solution')])
build(['/usr/bin/g++','-O2','-std=c++23','-I'+str(o),str(p/'official_checker.cpp'),'-o',str(p/'official_checker')])
old=json.loads((Path('/tmp/sirkit_hull_20261022')/'official_cases.json').read_text());assert len(old)==25
for c in old:
 inp=o/c['name'];assert sha(inp.read_bytes())==c['sha256'];q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','10',str(p/'official_solution')],input=inp.read_bytes(),capture_output=True);assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr;out=p/(c['name']+'.expected');out.write_bytes(q.stdout);d['fixtures'].append({'name':c['name'],'input':str(inp),'input_sha256':c['sha256'],'output':str(out),'output_sha256':sha(q.stdout)})
print('Official reference25 ready',flush=True)
configs=[('gcc_skip',['/usr/bin/g++'],[],False),('gcc_checked',['/usr/bin/g++'],[],True),('gcc_native',['/usr/bin/g++'],['-march=native','-DEVAL','-DONLINE_JUDGE'],False),('gcc_standard',['/usr/bin/g++'],['-DSIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC','-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD','-U__SIZEOF_INT128__'],False),('clang_skip',['clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'],[],False)]
for mode,cc,defs,checked in configs:
 for form in ['full','split']:
  source=r/f'Verify/current/submissions/geometry_convex_hull_{form}.cpp';s=source.read_text();assert s.startswith('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n') and '#include <atcoder'not in s
  if checked:s=s.replace('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n','',1)
  cpp=p/(mode+'_'+form+'.cpp');cpp.write_text(s);exe=cpp.with_suffix('');build([*cc,'-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic-errors',*defs,str(cpp),'-o',str(exe)]);d['builds'][-1]['source_sha256']=sha(cpp.read_bytes())
  for c in d['fixtures']:
   q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','10',str(exe)],input=Path(c['input']).read_bytes(),capture_output=True);assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr,(mode,form,c['name'],q.stderr)
   actual=p/'actual.out';actual.write_bytes(q.stdout);ch=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','10',str(p/'official_checker'),c['input'],str(actual),c['output']],capture_output=True,text=True);assert ch.returncode==0,(mode,form,c['name'],ch.stderr)
   assert sha(q.stdout)==c['output_sha256'],(mode,form,c['name'],'normalization would be needed')
   d['runs'].append({'mode':mode,'form':form,'case':c['name'],'output_sha256':sha(q.stdout),'checker_returncode':ch.returncode})
  print(mode,form,'25 official checker PASS',flush=True)
d['status']='PASS';(p/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
